lede: (five closures drawn up like patent sheets: the mechanism photographed open, numbered callouts, a parts list, one line of action.)
idea: Territory 05 of the original system was the clasp as design, and it has never been given a whole set. Nobody photographs a closure; every brand photographs the front. So each sheet shows the mechanism open — the bar mid-turn, the fold-over tongue up, the hoop's post swung out, the huggie on its hinge, the open-back shank from behind — with the callouts a patent draughtsman would add. The reader learns how it closes before they are asked to buy it.
type: The figure sits in a hairline frame with a FIG. caption tab, leader lines and circled numerals drawn as SVG over the photograph. The closure name is Velista at 118/140px with a Cormorant aside; the parts list is mono in a two-column grid with the same circled numerals; ACTION is a single Jost line. The sheet number lives in the top strip where a patent carries it.
review: Pass 1: three callouts on the toggle sheet landed on plaster rather than metal and one on the huggie sheet pointed at the out-of-focus twin; re-targeted from crops of the rendered figure. Pass 2: the story crop shifts the mechanism, so the story format got its own callout coordinates. All five plates were generated fresh — the archive never showed a single closure open.
verdict: the set that most clearly says 'made', which is the lane.

K1.title: Toggle
K1.why: The bar caught mid-turn through the ring, from the second toggle generation made for Set 01. Four callouts: bar, ring, paperclip link, chain.
K1.check: plain bar, plain ring, 4mm paperclip links, 50cm and 15mm from the listing

K2.title: Fold-over
K2.why: The Prism's clasp with its tongue folded up at ninety degrees so the box is readable, the first stones running away into soft focus.
K2.check: three colours only, pavé halos, fold-over (not lobster)

K3.title: Latch
K3.why: The woven hoop with its post swung out and the flat oval tab showing — the lock is the tab.
K3.check: open plait of several strands, no stones, 25mm

K4.title: Snap
K4.why: One huggie open on its hinge, the pin on one side and the snap post on the other, its closed twin far out of focus.

K5.title: Open back
K5.why: The Pavé Dome from behind: two tapered shank ends and the gap between them. No clasp at all; the band is the fitting. Four units in stock, so the button routes to Rings rather than the piece.
K5.check: pavé across the whole dome, open shank, rhodium
